groups.title: Real Estate Product
groups.stack: Flutter, Modular Feature-Based Clean Architecture, Melos Monorepo, BLoC, Scrum, Kanban
bullets: Built and maintained features of a real estate app with 10M+ users for a Saudi government client; analysed BRDs with BA, backend and QC, agreed API contracts, estimated tasks and demoed each epic to the client.
Built and maintained the shared design system library; reviewed teammates' pull requests.

groups.title: SiteLog – Site Inspection App
groups.stack: Swift, SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency, SwiftData, Clean Architecture, MVVM, Factory, Swift Testing
bullets: Built an offline-first iOS app for site supervisors to record site conditions and export a signed PDF inspection report.
Built a background URLSession upload engine with S3 multipart uploads that survives app suspension, termination and network loss across multi-GB sessions.
Made captures tamper-evident with SHA-256 hashes, a separate vector markup layer, an audit log and Keychain-held keys; added biometric and passcode lock.

Built PDFKit floor plans with pins, photo markup and stamps, checklists and BLE meter readings; added multi-device sync, realtime WebSocket progress, push and deep links; set up Fastlane and TestFlight CI/CD.

groups.title: Warehouse App for Handheld Devices
groups.stack: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MVVM, Clean Architecture
bullets: Built a warehouse management app end to end for Unitech HT300/HT330 handheld barcode scanners.
Integrated the built-in hardware scanner for live barcode capture; synced goods receipt, dispatch and inventory data.
